containers.name: run-schema-migration-container
command: mysql -h mysqldb -u root -ppassword -e "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='test' AND TABLE_NAME='ratings' AND COLUMN_NAME='created_at';" | grep -q '0' && mysql -h mysqldb -u root -ppassword -e "ALTER TABLE test.ratings ADD COLUMN created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;" || echo 'Column already exists'
